definition: Guillaume Verdon-Akzam, also known as Guillaume Verdon or Gill Verdon, is a Canadian mathematical physicist, quantum computing researcher, entrepreneur, and writer who is a key contributor of Google's quantum machine learning software, Tensorflow Quantum.
details: He is also a co-founder of the effective accelerationism movement and the start-up company Extropic AI which operates at the intersection between physics-based computing and artificial intelligence.

explainer.lead: Guillaume Verdon is a Canadian physicist and entrepreneur. His work spans quantum engineering, quantum machine learning, magnetoencephalography and information theory.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include effective accelerationism, Quantum analog-digital interconversion for encoding and decoding quantum signals, Quantum repeater from quantum analog-digital interconverter and Challenges and opportunities in quantum machine learning.

contributions.name: In 2017, Verdon co-founded Everettian Technologies and served as its chief scientific officer.

He also had a side venture into NFTs related to quantum information, which provided capital for his later startup Extropic AI.Verdon has worked at Google and had primary responsibility for theoretical work on the team that introduced the TensorFlow Quantum library for quantum machine learning.
During his time at Google X, Verdon introduced and worked on quantum graph neural networks, and quantum Hamiltonian-based models.

In 2022, Verdon and Trevor Mccourt co-founded Extropic AI, which focuses on building a thermodynamic hardware platform for accelerating AI research and announced the next year the completion of a $14.1 million seed round.

timeline.what: He attended University of Waterloo for graduate studies where he completed Master's work in 2017 at the Institute for Quantum Computing and continued with Achim Kempf as his PhD supervisor.
Verdon presented papers as a Guest Speaker at NASA's 2018 Adiabatic Quantum Computing conference.
In 2025, Wired reported that Verdon was continuing to work through Extropic AI on a new kind of chip that handles probabilistic bits instead of deterministic bits.
